content: Astro is at v7.x (7.1.6 as of late July 2026); static output mode is default when no server adapter installed, deploys as pure static files via 'astro build' to dist/, uploadable via plain FTP to shared hosting (set output:'static' explicitly, trailingSlash:'always' for shared-host URL consistency, 404.html handled via .htaccess ErrorDocument).
